reach.rationale: No experimental, preview, RC or canary APIs anywhere; the only 'very new' reach is one recently-stable API (goto shallow routing, 4 weeks stable) in a central place, plus the month-old SvelteKit 3 conventions the framework now mandates.

app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.svelte:13 — the only other goto call, one line in one event handler
app/src/lib/components/MoveTable.svelte:28 — sole untrack use, a one-line initializer
containment.rationale: Every new-API touchpoint is confined to a single file and wrapped in a helper; the remaining ~20 files use only long-stable runes, snippets and standard load/routing conventions, so nothing risky is spread around.

evidence: app/src/routes/+page.svelte:44-53 — shallow routing is the framework-recommended replacement for deprecated pushState/replaceState and avoids re-running server load on every search keystroke (SPEC requires URL-reflecting filters without reload)
app/src/lib/components/MoveTable.svelte:28 — untrack is the documented way to read props for non-reactive initial state
app/package.json:12-14 — #lib imports and vite.config.js plugin config are what SvelteKit 3 requires, not optional novelty
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.svelte:13 — the one weak spot: noScroll/keepFocus were removed in v3, showing the new option set wasn't carried through consistently
justification.rationale: Each new API solves a real problem the older stable options couldn't (shallow routing) or is mandated by v3 (config shape, #lib); the only knock is the half-finished adoption where one goto call still uses v2's removed options.

findings.issue: goto(url, { noScroll: true, keepFocus: true, replace: true }) uses options removed in SvelteKit 3 (replaced by reset, PR #16558); with kit 3.1.0 installed this hits the goto_options_removed error in dev and the options are ignored in production, losing the intended scroll/focus preservation
findings.suggestion: Change to goto(url, { reset: false, replace: true }), matching the correct usage already in app/src/routes/+page.svelte:48

findings.issue: The central filter/pagination flow depends on goto's shallow-routing options, which have only been stable since SvelteKit 3.0 (2026-10-01) and evolved as recently as 3.0.0-next.13 (2026-07-29); churn risk if options are renamed again
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as-is since the call is already wrapped in queryUrl/updateUrl helpers; pin the exact @sveltejs/kit minor version to absorb renames deliberately

findings.issue: The #lib subpath-import alias and imports field are SvelteKit-3 conventions only one month old, so most published examples and tooling assume the old $lib alias
findings.suggestion: Nothing to change — this is the correct v3 idiom — but note it in onboarding docs for contributors still on SvelteKit 2

summary: The app rides the current stable release (SvelteKit 3.1 / Svelte 5.57) with zero experimental, preview or canary APIs and no experimental config flags. Its one genuinely new dependency is goto's shallow-routing options, stable for only four weeks but used in the central filter UX, correctly contained behind helpers and well-justified (URL-synced filters without re-running load). The sole defect is a stale SvelteKit-2 goto call (noScroll/keepFocus) in the Pokémon page that should be reset: false.

experimentalApis.api: goto(url, { shallow: true, replace, reset, state }) — shallow routing
sveltekit Vite-plugin config in vite.config.js (svelte.config.js removed) + #lib subpath imports
